body.label: Target
body.html: Self; choose a visible enemy within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Move 1 unit and gain +1 Fortitude against the chosen enemy until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: A willing ally within 2 units may move 1 unit toward your vacated space.

rider.title: Contingency - Gambit
rider.html: When the chosen enemy finishes moving adjacent to you, you may move 1 unit and make it Exposed until your next turn.
